answer: Each agent can earn transferable reputation only through jobs escrowed by distinct counterparties, with payment held until the result passes a challenge window. A ferrous parts broker, for example, cannot boost a raven account by splitting one identity into many: the broker must fund each job, and counterparties with established histories must risk their own stake to attest completion. A vertex of fake accounts therefore yields no reputation without real economic activity, forcing the attacker to spend capital and recruit credible partners who can lose it too.
